# NKY Mold Removal Pros

## About
NKY Mold Removal Pros provides mold inspection, mold removal, and moisture control for homes and businesses in Northern Kentucky (Boone, Kenton, and Campbell counties). Free inspections by phone: (859) 900-8065.

## Services
- Mold inspection, with air or surface testing when needed
- Mold remediation: containment, HEPA filtration, removal of moldy materials, antimicrobial treatment
- Mold prevention: moisture control, dehumidification, crawl space encapsulation

## Service Areas
Florence, Covington, Fort Thomas, Newport, Fort Mitchell, Erlanger, Edgewood, and Independence, Kentucky.
